description: One merge rule (GX-22, B-18, D-070): how far behind its base a gated head may be, whether merge-phase pins the exact head and needs a mergeable PR, and the P-G3 switch. Readers: commit_check, merge-phase (merge_behind.py) and the train (GX-30).

merge.max_behind_base.description: GX-22 (B-18, D-070): most commits a gated head may be behind the current base tip. merge-phase re-gates a head beyond it (or behind with overlapping changes, merge.regate_on_overlap); with merge.tier1_requires_base_merge off it is also the commit-check limit for a head that carries no merge of the base. Shown as "N behind, limit M".

merge.paths_shown.description: Overlapping paths named in the re-gate reason.

merge.regate_on_overlap.description: Re-gate a head that is behind at all when the base's commits since the merge-base touched a path the PR also changed: the gate proved the PR against a base without those changes.

merge.require_exact_head.description: GX-22 (D-070): merge-phase merges only the exact gated head (--match-head-commit), so a push after the proof makes the merge fail instead of merging an unproven head. Off drops the pin; the proof is still read for the head merge-phase saw.

merge.tier1_requires_base_merge.description: P-G3 switch (GA-PG3 = P-47, D-070). Off (default since GX-27, after the train merged a real batch): a head behind by at most merge.max_behind_base passes without a merge of the base, because the train re-proves the batch on the tip. On (the earlier rule, one-key rollback): a tier-1 head behind its base must carry a merge commit of the base (commit_check.rebase_errors). Merge commits only, never a rebase, either way (FP1).
